dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Caramel Froyo has been observed to be highly fearful while in care. Noted to have a tense body, tucked tail, and is reluctant to interact with handlers. During their medical exam, Caramel was observed to growl at handlers and thrash. Due to the detailed behavior, we recommend an experienced adult-only home.
dog.name: Caramel Froyo
